description: Canonical DOGI (Doginals) indexer-split test case. The original 21M DOGI deploy and the later 2.1B DOGI deploy are treated differently by different indexers — this is the thesis we are proving.

original_deploy.note: Original 21M DOGI deploy. Some indexers recognize this as the canonical deploy.

later_deploy.note: Later 2.1B DOGI deploy. Some indexers recognize this instead of the original.

expected_behavior: Different indexers may report different 'canonical' deploys for DOGI. The proof is showing that compare_inscription returns different results across indexers for the same inscription_id.
